titulo: Why is my water heater banging?

frases.texto: Why is your water heater banging?
If it pops while it heats, chalk is trapping steam on the bottom.
Shut a faucet and it bangs right then? That's the pipes. Call a plumber.
If it's gas, stop and call a plumber. Electric? Flip the breaker off.
Shut the cold valve on the inlet pipe.
Open a hot faucet upstairs, and leave it running.
Now wait until the tank is cool.
Hose on the drain, into a tub. Open the valve.
Crack the cold valve. Blast it until the water runs clear. Then close the drain.
Open that cold valve all the way.
Upstairs, the faucet stops spitting and runs steady.
Only then do you flip the breaker back on.
Once a year. Hard water, every six months. Skip it, and the tank cooks itself.
Still banging, a leak, or eight years old? Call a pro.
Send this to that friend whose water heater sounds like a kettle.
